LESSON: SELECTED SURAH

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Selected Surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Selected Surah. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. handle the Qur’an with care and respect 117 surah.
2. appreciate the importance of reciting the selected surah to get blessings from Allah. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Imagination and creativity, Digital literacy, Learning to learn.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. handle the Qur’an with care and respect 117 surah.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to handle the Qur’an with care and respect 117 surah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the importance of reciting the selected surah to get blessings from Allah. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Imagination and creativity, Digital literacy, Learning to learn.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of reciting the selected surah to get blessings from Allah. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Imagination and creativity, Digital literacy, Learning to learn. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Selected Surah.
2. Explain Selected Surah to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners name the pillars of Iman. 1. Who created you? IMAN 2.1.1 Belief in Allah strand the learner should be
4. Show that you can: handle the Qur’an with care and respect 117 surah.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Surah. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Selected Surah important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners name the pillars of Iman. 1. Who created you? IMAN 2.1.1 Belief in Allah strand the learner should be
2. Learners are engaged in discussion on the 2.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. handle the Qur’an with care and respect 117 surah.
2. appreciate the importance of reciting the selected surah to get blessings from Allah. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Imagination and creativity, Digital literacy, Learning to learn.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
